messages:
sarah: Quick heads-up — we started seeing a regression on Mixtral-8B serving after the kernel swap tonight. p50 up ~18% at low conc (1-4), and throughput drops at high conc. Suspect interaction between RoPE scaling and KV-layout (GQA->MQA). :eyes:

mike: Repro steps? can you paste the exact command and model config you used?

sarah: repro command: `./bench --model mixtral-8b --seq 1024 --concurrency 2 --warm 50 --iters 200`
config snippet: ```model: mixtral-8b
num_key_value_heads: 32
kv_head_dim: 64
rope_scale: 1.0
quantized: true
```

benchbot: automated profile (short): ```kernel_selector: fallback->gemm_fp32
avg_infer_ms: 72.3 (prev 61.5)
90th_infer_ms: 132.8 (prev 97.4)
throughput_tok/s: 14500 (prev 16200)
kv_page_frag_ratio: 0.27
cache_slots_allocated: 2048 -> 2560 (waste: 20%)
```

ana: I saw something similar on Qwen last week — kernel chooser fell back to fp32 for layers with atypical head_count alignment. Might be because the quantized matmul kernels assume contiguous per-head layout and a specific kv_head_dim multiple.

mike: Also noticed batching heuristics changed on host-group A (window bumped from 4ms -> 8ms to increase aggregate throughput). That helps throughput but makes slow kernel fallbacks visible in the latency tail.

josh: Quick note on KV sizing: GQA config we used has num_kv_heads=32, kv_head_dim=64 => total KV projection 2048. MQA routes often have num_kv_heads=8, kv_head_dim=128 => 1024 total, but layout per-head differs which trips the kernel selector. Paging configured with page_size=8 slots currently which causes fragmentation when head counts don't divide page_size.

priya: I pushed a small kernel-hint patch to prefer quantized path when model.qconfig.present and when head_count * head_dim % 32 == 0 (PR #4721). Also added a kv-page compaction pass to reduce fragmentation on alloc. Patch id: `fix/kernel-hints-4721`

sarah: Can we change default cache sizing for GQA vs MQA? My thinking: for Mixtral experiments we observed the biggest waste when page_size is static. Proposal: per-model kv_page_size override and slot allocation based on total_kv_dim / page_unit. Example numbers from today: GQA total_kv_dim 2048 => prefer page_size 16; MQA total_kv_dim 1024 => prefer page_size 8.

mike: Measured numbers from local bench: Mixtral w/ num_kv_heads=32, kv_head_dim=64 —> ideal page_size 16 gives fragmentation 0.08 and throughput +6%. For MQA layout (8x128) page_size 8 still best. When we force page_size 8 for GQA, fragmentation jumps to 0.31 and we see allocator overhead +12%.

ana: RoPE scaling gotcha: some quantized kernels apply scale as int8 rounding at the wrong stage, which underflows rotary coefficients for long sequences and causes the kernel selector to mark the layer incompatible -> fallback. We should ensure the kernel capability matrix includes (rope_scaled, head_count, kv_layout_signature) so selector doesn't conservatively fallback.

josh: Deployed hotfix to kernel selector this morning to include head_count & kv_layout_signature in capability checks and to prefer quantized path when qconfig exists. Early numbers from canary: p50 down ~6% (from worst), throughput up ~4% on 1k-token bench. Still watching tail.

benchbot: CI bench summary: https://console.redwood.ai/bench/mixtral/1847654321
CI lines: ```canary.p50: 64.2ms -> 60.3ms
canary.p90: 118.6ms -> 105.7ms
canary.throughput: 15400 -> 16000
kv_frag_ratio: 0.27 -> 0.10
```

priya: Next steps: add per-model page_size override config, extend kernel selector signatures, and run a focused MQA stress test with kv_page_size=16 just to validate compaction doesn't regress memory spike. PRs: #4721 (kernel hint), #4726 (kv compaction), #4730 (per-model page_size).

sarah: Thanks. Assigning follow-ups: @mike run the MQA stress with kv_page_size=16 and attach perf traces; @ana validate qwen/mistral variants for rope-scale mismatch; @josh monitor canary logs for 24h. We'll reconvene after the 24h window. :thumbsup:
